"Bad Things" is a song written and recorded by American singer Jace Everett.
It is included on his only album for Epic Records Nashville, the self-titled Jace Everett.
Although released as a single in 2005, it did not chart on the Hot Country Songs charts that year.
Jace Everett Beasley (born May 27, 1972) is an American singer-songwriter and musician.
Signed to Epic Records in 2005, he released his debut single "That's the Kind of Love I'm In" in 2005, which peaked at No.
52 on the Billboard Hot Country Songs charts, and was the first single from his self-titled debut album.
